exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
cohort: The study reviews optimal care for mothers experiencing antepartum stillbirth.
finding: Vaginal delivery, primarily through induction of labor, is generally recommended as the preferred mode for most antepartum stillbirths due to lower maternal morbidity compared to caesarean section.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery is generally preferred for antepartum stillbirths due to lower maternal morbidity than caesarean section, and the mode of delivery can also influence maternal mental health.
